IHrmPlatformPermission.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for querying the permission catalog with filtering and pagination support.

This type defines the search criteria and pagination controls for retrieving permission definitions from the hrm_platform_permissions table. Use it to filter permissions by code pattern or description keywords, include or exclude soft-deleted records, and navigate through paginated results.

The code field performs partial matching on permission codes using SQL LIKE (e.g., 'employee' matches 'employee:manage' and 'employee:view'). The description field supports full-text search on permission descriptions. The deleted flag filters by soft-delete status - when true, only soft-deleted records are returned; when false, only active records; when omitted or null, active records are returned by default.

Pagination is controlled by page and limit parameters, with a maximum of 100 items per page. Results are sorted by code ascending by default, but you can customize sorting using the sort field with optional direction (e.g., 'code DESC').

Maps to search fields: code (partial match LIKE on permission code), description (full-text search on description), deleted (boolean filter translating to deleted_at nullability check). Pagination via page/limit, sorting via sort field. No direct DB mapping for page, limit, sort - these are query control parameters. The deleted_at column is filtered indirectly via the deleted boolean parameter.

email.description:
Unique email address used for authentication and communication.

This email serves as the primary identifier for login and password recovery processes. Must be unique across all member accounts in the system. The email address is used to send verification tokens, password reset links, and system notifications.

Format must follow standard email conventions (RFC 5322). Maximum length is 255 characters. The system performs case-insensitive uniqueness checks to prevent duplicate accounts with different casing.

password.description:
Plain text password for account authentication.

This password is used to authenticate the member during login. The plain text value is never stored; it is hashed using bcrypt or argon2 before being persisted to the database.

Password must meet security requirements: minimum 8 characters in length, at least one uppercase letter (A-Z), at least one lowercase letter (a-z), and at least one numeric digit (0-9). Stronger passwords are encouraged but not enforced beyond these minimum requirements.

href.description:
Current page URL where registration was initiated.

This field records the exact URL of the registration page when the user submitted their registration form. Used for audit trails, analytics, and understanding user acquisition funnels.

The value is stored in the session record (hrm_platform_member_sessions) rather than the member record, as it pertains to the specific registration session rather than the member account itself. Format must be a valid URI.

Referrer URL that led to the registration page.

This field records the URL of the page the user visited immediately before arriving at the registration page. Used for attribution tracking, marketing analytics, and understanding user navigation patterns.

The value is stored in the session record (hrm_platform_member_sessions) rather than the member record, as it pertains to the specific registration session. Format must be a valid URI. May be empty if the user navigated directly or if referrer information is not available.

ip.description:
Client IP address at time of registration.

This field records the IP address from which the registration request was made. Used for security auditing, fraud detection, and geographic analytics.

The value is stored in the session record (hrm_platform_member_sessions) rather than the member record, as it pertains to the specific registration session. This field is optional to support server-side rendering scenarios where the client cannot determine its own IP address - in such cases, the server captures the IP as a fallback. Format must be a valid IPv4 address when provided.

IHrmPlatformMember.IJoin.description:
Registration credentials for creating a new member account.

Contains the email address and password required to create a new authenticated user account. Email must be unique across all members and follows standard email format. Password must meet security requirements: minimum 8 characters, at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number.

The href and referrer fields capture the registration context for audit and analytics purposes. The ip field records the client's IP address when available, but is optional to support server-side rendering scenarios where the client cannot determine its own IP.

Upon successful registration, an email verification token is generated and sent asynchronously to the provided email address. JWT access and refresh tokens are returned in the response for immediate authentication. New members have no organization membership initially and must create or join an organization to access organization-scoped features.

This type is returned when a guest account is created via the join operation or when refreshing an existing guest session. The response includes the guest's unique identifier and a token object containing the access token, refresh token, and expiration timestamps.

The access token is used for authenticating subsequent API requests. The refresh token is used to obtain new access tokens when the current one expires via the refresh operation. The expired_at timestamp indicates when the access token expires, and refreshable_until indicates the absolute session expiration deadline.

id.description:

organization.description:

name.description:

isBuiltIn.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_roles.is_built_in. Boolean flag set to true for system-provided roles (Owner, Manager, Employee), false for custom roles.

Primarily used for custom roles to document their intended permissions and responsibilities. Built-in roles may have null descriptions as their purposes are well-defined (Owner has full access, Manager can manage employees and projects, Employee has basic access). Displayed in role management interfaces to help administrators understand role purposes.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_roles.description. Nullable string - null for built-in roles or custom roles without description.

createdAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_roles.created_at. ISO 8601 date-time format, automatically set on role creation.

Timestamp when the role was last modified.

Automatically updated whenever the role's name, description, or permissions are changed. Built-in roles typically have the same createdAt and updatedAt values unless their permissions were modified. Custom roles show the most recent modification time. Used for change tracking and cache invalidation.
updatedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_roles.updated_at. ISO 8601 date-time format, automatically updated on any role modification.

IHrmPlatformRole.description:
Complete role definition within an organization, including built-in roles (Owner, Manager, Employee) and custom roles with configurable permission sets.

Roles define access control boundaries within an organization. Built-in roles are system-provided and cannot be deleted, while custom roles can be created by organization owners with specific permission combinations. Each role belongs to exactly one organization and has a unique name within that organization.

The organization property provides the parent organization context. The isBuiltIn flag indicates whether this is a system-provided role that cannot be modified or deleted. Custom roles can be edited and deleted if no employees are assigned to them.

Excluded: deleted_at (soft delete system field), organization_id (replaced by organization object), rolePermissions/employees/employeeInvitations (has-many relations exposed via separate endpoints).

id.description:
Unique identifier for the permission record.

id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_permissions.id. UUID format primary key.

code.description:
Permission code identifier in 'domain:action' format.

This code uniquely identifies the permission throughout the system for authorization checks. The format follows a consistent pattern where the domain represents the resource area (e.g., 'org', 'employee', 'project', 'time', 'report') and the action represents the allowed operation (e.g., 'manage', 'view', 'approve').

Examples include 'org:manage' for organization settings management, 'employee:view' for viewing employee lists, and 'time:approve' for approving timesheets.
code.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_permissions.code. Unique constraint enforced at database level. Format: 'domain:action'.

description.description:
Human-readable explanation of what this permission allows.

This description helps administrators understand the purpose of each permission when creating or editing custom roles. It should clearly state what actions or resources the permission grants access to, making role configuration more intuitive.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_permissions.description. Human-readable text explaining the permission's purpose.

created_at.description:

created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_permissions.created_at. ISO 8601 date-time format with timezone.

IHrmPlatformPermission.ISummary.description:

The code field identifies the permission in 'domain:action' format (e.g., 'employee:manage', 'project:view'), while the description provides a human-readable explanation of what the permission allows.

The id field serves as the unique identifier for internal operations, and created_at indicates when the permission was added to the system. This summary type is optimized for list views and dropdown selections, excluding audit fields like updated_at that are not needed for permission selection interfaces.

Results are filtered to exclude soft-deleted records (deleted_at IS NULL) by default. IHrmPlatformRole.IUpdate.description:

Accepts one of four status values: open (new/unstarted tasks), in-progress (actively being worked on), completed (work finished), or closed (finalized and archived). When omitted, returns tasks regardless of status.
status.x-autobe-specification: Filter by exact match on hrm_platform_tasks.status column. Valid values: open, in-progress, completed, closed. Optional parameter - when omitted, returns tasks of all statuses.

priority.description:
Filter tasks by their priority level.

Accepts one of four priority values: low (can be deferred), medium (normal priority), high (important, should be addressed soon), or urgent (critical, immediate attention required). When omitted, returns tasks regardless of priority.
priority.x-autobe-specification: Filter by exact match on hrm_platform_tasks.priority column. Valid values: low, medium, high, urgent. Optional parameter - when omitted, returns tasks of all priority levels.

assignedEmployeeId.description:
Filter tasks by assigned employee or unassigned status.

Pass a valid employee UUID to retrieve only tasks assigned to that employee. Pass null explicitly to retrieve unassigned backlog tasks. When omitted, returns tasks regardless of assignment status.
assignedEmployeeId.x-autobe-specification: Filter by hrm_platform_tasks.assigned_employee_id FK column. Pass UUID to find tasks assigned to specific employee. Pass null to find unassigned backlog tasks. Optional - when omitted, returns all tasks regardless of assignment.

search.description:
Full-text search across task titles and descriptions.

Performs case-insensitive substring matching against both the title and description fields. Useful for finding tasks by keyword or topic. When omitted, no text filtering is applied.
search.x-autobe-specification: Text search across hrm_platform_tasks.title and hrm_platform_tasks.description columns using LIKE operator. Case-insensitive substring matching. Optional - when omitted, no text filtering applied.

sort.description:
Field to sort results by.

Accepts one of three values: dueDate (sorts by task due date, null values appear last), priority (sorts by urgency: urgent, high, medium, low), or createdAt (sorts by creation timestamp). When omitted, defaults to sorting by createdAt.
sort.x-autobe-specification: Specifies which field to sort by: dueDate (hrm_platform_tasks.due_date, nulls last), priority (enum order: urgent > high > medium > low), or createdAt (hrm_platform_tasks.created_at). Optional - defaults to createdAt if omitted.

sortDirection.description:
Direction of sorting applied to results.

Accepts asc for ascending order or desc for descending order. Works in conjunction with the sort field parameter. When omitted, defaults to ascending order.
sortDirection.x-autobe-specification: Sort direction: asc (ascending) or desc (descending). Works in conjunction with sort field. Optional - defaults to asc if omitted.

limit.description:
Maximum number of task records to return per page.

Accepts an integer value between 1 and 100. Controls the page size for pagination. When omitted, defaults to 20 records per page. The actual number of records returned may be less on the final page.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Maximum number of records per page. Integer between 1 and 100. Optional - defaults to 20 if omitted. Used for cursor-based pagination.

cursor.description:
Pagination cursor for navigating through result pages.

Opaque string token obtained from the previous page's response metadata. Use this to retrieve the next or previous page of results. When omitted or null, returns the first page of results.
cursor.x-autobe-specification: Opaque cursor string for cursor-based pagination. Obtained from previous page's response metadata. Optional - when omitted or null, returns first page.

page.description:
Target page number to retrieve (1-indexed).

Specifies which page of results to return. Page numbering starts from 1. If omitted, null, or 0, defaults to page 1 (first page). Requesting a page beyond the available range returns an empty data array with valid pagination metadata reflecting the actual totals.
page.x-autobe-specification: 1-indexed page number for pagination. Integer >= 0 (0 or null means page 1). Optional - defaults to 1 if omitted. Alternative to cursor-based navigation.

IHrmPlatformTask.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for filtering, sorting, and paginating tasks within a project.

This type defines the search criteria for retrieving tasks from a specific project. All fields are optional, allowing flexible queries from unfiltered browsing to highly specific searches.

**Filters**: Use status to filter by workflow state, priority for urgency level, and assignedEmployeeId to find tasks assigned to a specific employee or null for unassigned backlog items. The search field performs text matching against task titles and descriptions.

**Sorting**: Control result ordering with sort (field name) and sortDirection (ascending or descending). Supported sort fields are dueDate, priority, and createdAt.

**Pagination**: Uses cursor-based pagination with limit for page size (1-100) and cursor for navigating through result pages. Page parameter provides 1-indexed page number support.
IHrmPlatformTask.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Query parameters for filtering hrm_platform_tasks table. status: exact match on status column (open, in-progress, completed, closed). priority: exact match on priority column (low, medium, high, urgent). assignedEmployeeId: filter by assigned_employee_id FK, null value matches unassigned tasks. search: LIKE search on title and description columns. sort: field name for ordering (dueDate, priority, createdAt). sortDirection: asc or desc. limit: page size (1-100, default 20). cursor: opaque cursor string for cursor-based pagination. page: 1-indexed page number, defaults to 1. Backend validates user is project member or has project:manage permission before executing query.

id.description:
Unique identifier for this project membership record.

Auto-generated UUID assigned when the membership record is created. This identifier is immutable and serves as the primary key for referencing this specific employee-project assignment.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_project_members.id. Auto-generated UUID on insert. System-managed, immutable after creation.

employee.description:
The employee assigned to this project.

Contains summary information about the employee including their position, employment type, activation status, and associated user account. The employee must be active and belong to the same organization as the project to be assigned.
employee.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping via JOIN from hrm_platform_project_members.employee to hrm_platform_employees. Returns IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary containing essential employee information (id, position, employment_type, status, member, role, department).

project.description:
The project this employee is assigned to.

Contains summary information about the project including its name, color code for UI display, lifecycle status, and owning organization. Only active projects can receive new project member assignments.
project.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping via JOIN from hrm_platform_project_members.project to hrm_platform_projects. Returns IHrmPlatformProject.ISummary containing essential project information (id, name, color, status, organization, budget_hours, dates).

role.description:
Role designation for this employee within the project.

Two possible values: 'member' allows viewing tasks and logging time against the project. 'project-lead' includes all member capabilities plus additional permissions to create, edit, and manage tasks within the project. This role is assigned when the employee is added to the project and can be updated by users with project:manage permission.
role.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_project_members.role. Valid values: 'member' or 'project-lead'. Determines the employee's capabilities within the project context.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when this project membership was created.

Automatically set by the system when the employee is first assigned to the project. This timestamp is immutable and provides an audit trail of when the project access was granted.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_project_members.created_at. System-managed timestamp set to current time on record insertion. Immutable after creation.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when this project membership was last modified.

Automatically updated by the system whenever any property of this membership record is changed, such as when the role is updated from 'member' to 'project-lead'. Provides an audit trail of the most recent modification.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_project_members.updated_at. System-managed timestamp updated on every record modification. Reflects the last time any property of this membership was changed.

IHrmPlatformProjectMember.description:
Project membership record assigning an employee to a project with a designated role.

This DTO represents the junction between employees and projects, establishing which employees have access to which projects. The assigned role determines the employee's capabilities within the project context: 'member' role allows viewing tasks and logging time, while 'project-lead' role additionally enables task management operations such as creating and editing tasks.

This is a Read DTO used in API responses. It includes full object references to the assigned employee and project, along with system timestamps tracking when the assignment was created and last modified. Used as the response body for project member creation and retrieval operations.
IHrmPlatformProjectMember.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_project_members table. Scalar fields: id, role, created_at, updated_at. Relations: employee via JOIN to hrm_platform_employees (returns ISummary), project via JOIN to hrm_platform_projects (returns ISummary). FK columns hrm_platform_employee_id and hrm_platform_project_id are transformed to object references in this Read DTO. No computed fields. All timestamps are system-managed (created_at on insert, updated_at on update).

id.description:
Unique identifier for the employee contract record.

This is the primary key of the contract record, automatically generated as a UUID when the contract is created. Used to reference this specific contract in API operations such as retrieval and updates.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_contracts.id. UUID format generated by database.

employee.description:
The employee this contract belongs to.

This property references the employee record associated with this contract through a database join. The employee summary includes their identity, position, employment type, and role within the organization. Each contract is tied to exactly one employee, and an employee can have multiple contracts over their tenure creating a historical employment record.
employee.x-autobe-specification: JOIN from hrm_platform_employee_contracts.hrm_platform_employee_id to hrm_platform_employees.id. Returns IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary with employee identity and organizational context.

start_date.description:
The date when this contract's employment terms begin.

This required field marks the start of the employment period covered by this contract. It is used to determine contract chronology and automatically ends any previous active contract by setting its end_date to the day before this start_date. The value cannot be modified after creation as it affects the historical contract timeline.
start_date.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_contracts.start_date. DateTime with timestamptz format. Required field marking the beginning of the employment period.

end_date.description:
The date when this contract's employment terms conclude.

This optional field indicates when the contract expires or ended. A null value means the contract is currently active and ongoing. When a new contract is created for an employee, the previous active contract's end_date is automatically set to the day before the new contract's start_date. Only one contract per employee can have a null end_date at any time.
end_date.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_contracts.end_date. DateTime with timestamptz format, nullable. Null value indicates the contract is currently active and ongoing.

pay_rate.description:
The compensation amount per pay period.

This required numeric value represents the employee's pay rate under this contract. The value is interpreted according to the pay_period field - for example, an hourly rate if pay_period is 'hourly', or a monthly salary if pay_period is 'monthly'. Stored as double precision to support decimal values for accurate currency representation.
pay_rate.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_contracts.pay_rate. Double precision numeric value representing compensation amount per pay period.

pay_period.description:
The frequency of pay compensation.

This required field specifies the pay period unit that determines how the pay_rate value should be interpreted. Valid values are: hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly. This classification is used for payroll calculations, employment reporting, and contract management workflows.
pay_period.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_contracts.pay_period. String enum value: hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly. Determines how pay_rate should be interpreted.

working_hours_per_week.description:
The expected weekly working hours under this contract.

This required integer represents the standard working hours per week for this employee (e.g., 40 for full-time employment). Used for capacity planning, timesheet validation, employment classification, and determining full-time versus part-time status.
working_hours_per_week.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_contracts.working_hours_per_week. Integer representing expected standard working hours per week.

notes.description:
Optional additional contract terms or comments.

This optional free-form text field stores supplementary contract information such as special conditions, benefits, or other employment terms not captured in structured fields. Can be null for contracts without detailed supplementary notes.
notes.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_contracts.notes. Nullable string for supplementary contract information.

created_at.description:
The timestamp when this contract record was created.

This system-managed field records when the contract was initially created in the database. Automatically populated by the database on insertion and cannot be modified. Used for audit trail and chronological tracking of contract records.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_contracts.created_at. DateTime with timestamptz format, automatically set by database on record insertion.

updated_at.description:
The timestamp when this contract record was last updated.

This system-managed field records the most recent modification time for the contract record. Automatically updated by the database whenever any field in the contract is modified. Used for audit trail and tracking contract changes over time.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_contracts.updated_at. DateTime with timestamptz format, automatically updated by database on each record modification.

deleted_at.description:
The timestamp when this contract record was soft deleted.

This system-managed field is null for active contract records and populated with a timestamp when the record is soft deleted. Soft deletion preserves historical data while marking records as deleted. Past contracts are typically immutable but can be soft deleted if needed for data correction.
deleted_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_contracts.deleted_at. DateTime with timestamptz format, nullable. Null means record is active, populated timestamp indicates soft deletion.

IHrmPlatformEmployeeContract.description:
Complete employee contract record containing employment terms, compensation details, and contract duration.

This DTO represents a full contract entity including all employment terms such as pay rate, pay period, expected working hours, and the contract's temporal boundaries. The contract references the employee it belongs to through the employee property, which provides a summary of the employee's identity and organizational context.

The end_date field is null for currently active contracts, indicating ongoing employment under these terms. Historical contracts have a populated end_date marking when those terms concluded. The notes field captures any supplementary employment conditions or comments.

System-managed timestamps (created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) provide audit trail information. The deleted_at field is null for active records and populated when a contract record is soft deleted.
IHrmPlatformEmployeeContract.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_contracts table. All scalar columns mapped directly: id, start_date, end_date, pay_rate, pay_period, working_hours_per_week, notes, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at. Relation: employee via JOIN on hrm_platform_employee_id to hrm_platform_employees, returned as IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary $ref. Query filters out soft-deleted records (deleted_at is not null) at the database level.

id.description:
Unique identifier of the project.

Auto-generated UUID assigned when the project is created. Used as the primary key for all project operations and as the path parameter in project-specific endpoints.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.id. UUID format generated on creation.

organization.description:
The organization that owns this project.

All projects belong to exactly one organization for multi-tenancy isolation. This nested object provides organization context including name, currency, and timezone. The organization cannot be changed after project creation.
organization.x-autobe-specification: Join from hrm_platform_projects.organization_id to hrm_platform_organizations.id. Returns IHrmPlatformOrganization.ISummary with essential organization fields.

name.description:
Project name for identification within the organization.

Required field that uniquely identifies the project. Used in UI displays, reports, and when assigning timelogs to projects. Must be non-empty and should be descriptive of the project's purpose.
name.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.name. Required non-empty string for project identification.

description.description:
Optional detailed description of project scope and objectives.

Provides context about what the project aims to accomplish. Can contain markdown or plain text. Null when no description has been provided. Displayed in project detail views.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.description. Nullable string for project context.

color.description:
Hex color code for UI visual distinction.

Required field used to visually distinguish projects in calendars, task boards, and reports. Format should be valid hex color (e.g., '#FF5733' or 'FF5733'). Helps users quickly identify projects across the interface.
color.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.color. Required hex color code for UI visual distinction.

status.description:
Project lifecycle status controlling work availability.

Three states: 'active' for ongoing projects accepting new timelogs, 'archived' for preserved reference projects that cannot receive new work, and 'completed' for finished initiatives. Status changes are logged in activity logs. Transitioning to archived or completed prevents new timelogs from being recorded.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.status. String column with values 'active', 'archived', 'completed'. Controls timelog availability.

budget_hours.description:
Optional total estimated hours for project capacity planning.

Represents the planned effort for the project. Used for tracking progress against estimates and generating budget utilization reports. Null when no budget has been defined. Displayed in project budget reports showing percentage consumed.
budget_hours.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.budget_hours. Nullable number for capacity planning.

start_date.description:
Optional project start date for timeline tracking.

Indicates when project work began or is scheduled to begin. Used for Gantt charts, timeline views, and duration calculations. Null for projects without defined start dates. ISO 8601 format with timezone.
start_date.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.start_date. Nullable ISO date-time for timeline tracking.

end_date.description:
Optional project end date or deadline.

Indicates when project work is expected to be completed. Used for deadline tracking, overdue alerts, and timeline visualization. Null for ongoing projects without fixed end dates. ISO 8601 format with timezone.
end_date.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.end_date. Nullable ISO date-time for deadline tracking.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the project was created.

Automatically set when the project is first created. Used for audit trails, sorting projects by age, and determining project creation order. Immutable after creation. ISO 8601 format with timezone.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.created_at. Auto-set timestamp on project creation.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when the project was last updated.

Automatically updated whenever any project field is modified. Used for change tracking, cache invalidation, and identifying recently modified projects. ISO 8601 format with timezone.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.updated_at. Auto-updated timestamp on any project modification.

deleted_at.description:
Timestamp when the project was soft deleted.

Null for active projects. When set, marks the project as deleted while preserving the record for audit and reference purposes. Deleted projects are excluded from normal queries and cannot receive new timelogs. ISO 8601 format with timezone.
deleted_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.deleted_at. Nullable timestamp indicating soft deletion. Null means active project.

IHrmPlatformProject.description:
Complete project record with all attributes including identification, timeline, budget, and status information.

Projects are the core unit of work management within an organization, containing tasks and assigned team members. Each project belongs to exactly one organization for multi-tenancy isolation. The project lifecycle status (active, archived, completed) controls whether new timelogs can be recorded against it.

This Read DTO includes all project attributes: name for identification, color code for UI visual distinction, optional description for context, budget hours for capacity planning, optional start and end dates for timeline tracking, and system timestamps. The organization relation is included as a nested object for context. Has-many relations (tasks, project members, timelogs) are excluded and available via separate endpoints.
IHrmPlatformProject.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects table. Query by primary key id (UUID). Join organization relation to hrm_platform_organizations for the organization object. Exclude has-many relations (projectMemberships, tasks, timelogs, timers) - these have separate endpoints. Return all scalar columns including system timestamps and soft-delete marker.

dateFrom.description:
Start date for filtering timelogs by work date range.

When specified, only timelogs with a date on or after this value are included in the results. Uses ISO 8601 date-time format (e.g., '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'). The time component is typically ignored as timelog dates represent calendar dates.
dateFrom.x-autobe-specification: Filters hrm_platform_timelogs.date column with >= comparison. ISO date-time string format. When provided, only timelogs on or after this date are included.

dateTo.description:
End date for filtering timelogs by work date range.

When specified, only timelogs with a date on or before this value are included in the results. Uses ISO 8601 date-time format (e.g., '2024-12-31T23:59:59Z'). The time component is typically ignored as timelog dates represent calendar dates.
dateTo.x-autobe-specification: Filters hrm_platform_timelogs.date column with <= comparison. ISO date-time string format. When provided, only timelogs on or before this date are included.

hrmPlatformProjectId.description:
Filter timelogs by specific project.

Accepts a UUID string representing the project ID, or null to include timelogs from all projects. When provided, only timelogs recorded against the specified project are returned. The project must be one that the authenticated user has access to within their organization.
hrmPlatformProjectId.x-autobe-specification: Filters hrm_platform_timelogs.hrm_platform_project_id FK column. Accepts UUID string or null. When null, matches timelogs from all projects. Must be a valid project ID within the user's organization.

hrmPlatformTaskId.description:
Filter timelogs by specific task.

Accepts a UUID string representing the task ID, or null to include timelogs at the project level (without task assignment). When a task ID is provided, only timelogs recorded against that specific task are returned. The task must belong to the project specified in hrmPlatformProjectId if both filters are used.
hrmPlatformTaskId.x-autobe-specification: Filters hrm_platform_timelogs.hrm_platform_task_id FK column. Accepts UUID string or null. When null, matches timelogs without task assignment (project-level logging). When a UUID, matches timelogs assigned to that specific task.

hrmPlatformTimesheetId.description:
Filter timelogs by timesheet assignment status.

Accepts a UUID string representing the timesheet ID, or null to match timelogs not yet assigned to any timesheet. When null, returns draft timelogs that have not been included in a timesheet submission. When a timesheet ID is provided, returns only timelogs included in that specific timesheet.
hrmPlatformTimesheetId.x-autobe-specification: Filters hrm_platform_timelogs.hrm_platform_timesheet_id FK column. Accepts UUID string or null. When null, matches timelogs not yet assigned to any timesheet (draft/unsubmitted). When a UUID, matches timelogs included in that specific timesheet.

billable.description:
Filter timelogs by billable status.

When set to true, returns only timelogs marked as billable (charged to clients). When set to false, returns only non-billable timelogs (internal work, training, administrative tasks). When omitted from the request, both billable and non-billable timelogs are included in the results.
billable.x-autobe-specification: Filters hrm_platform_timelogs.billable boolean column. When true, returns only billable timelogs. When false, returns only non-billable timelogs. When omitted, returns both billable and non-billable timelogs.

page.description:
Page number for pagination.

Specifies which page of results to retrieve. Page numbering starts from 1 (first page). Must be a positive integer. When omitted, defaults to page 1. Used in combination with the limit parameter to control the number of records returned per page.
page.x-autobe-specification: Pagination parameter for cursor-based pagination. Integer >= 1. Defaults to 1 if not provided. Controls which page of results to return. Used with limit to calculate offset.

limit.description:
Maximum number of records per page.

Controls how many timelog records are returned in a single page. Must be between 1 and 100 (inclusive). When omitted, uses the system default page size. The actual number of records returned may be less than this value on the final page or when fewer total records exist.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Pagination parameter controlling maximum records per page. Integer between 1 and 100. Defaults to system default if not provided. Enforces upper bound of 100 records per page for performance.

sort.description:
Sort order for the result set.

Specifies which field to sort by and the sort direction. Format is 'fieldName:direction' where direction is either 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Common sort options include 'date:desc' for most recent timelogs first, or 'created_at:asc' for chronological order. When omitted, defaults to sorting by date in descending order.
sort.x-autobe-specification: Sorting parameter specifying field and direction. Format: 'field:asc' or 'field:desc'. Common values: 'date:desc', 'created_at:desc'. When omitted, defaults to 'date:desc' (most recent first).

IHrmPlatformTimelog.IRequest.description:
Search criteria for filtering and paginating timelog records.

This type defines the filter parameters for querying timelogs. All fields are optional, allowing users to combine filters as needed. Date range filters accept ISO date-time strings. Foreign key filters accept UUID strings or null to match unassigned records. The billable filter distinguishes between billable and non-billable time entries.

Pagination is controlled through page and limit parameters. The sort field specifies which field to order by and the direction (ascending or descending).
IHrmPlatformTimelog.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Request body for PATCH /hrmPlatform/member/timelogs. Maps to query filters on hrm_platform_timelogs table. dateFrom/dateTo filter the date column range (inclusive). hrmPlatformProjectId filters hrm_platform_project_id FK (nullable for all projects). hrmPlatformTaskId filters hrm_platform_task_id FK (null matches unassigned tasks). hrmPlatformTimesheetId filters hrm_platform_timesheet_id FK (null matches draft/unassigned timelogs). billable filters the billable boolean. page/limit control cursor-based pagination. sort specifies ordering field and direction. Actor identity (hrm_platform_employee_id) is resolved from JWT, not from request body.

Only pending invitations can be updated.

IHrmPlatformTask.ICreate.description:
Request payload for creating a new task within a project.

Contains the task's title and priority as required fields, with optional description, status, estimated effort, due date, employee assignment, and parent task reference for subtasks.

The created task is associated with the project specified in the path parameter. Status defaults to 'open' if not specified. Only one level of subtask nesting is supported.
IHrmPlatformTask.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: Maps to hrm_platform_tasks table columns: title, description, status, priority, estimated_hours, due_date, assigned_employee_id, parent_task_id. Excludes: id (auto-generated UUID), hrm_platform_project_id (from path parameter {projectId}), created_at/updated_at/deleted_at (system timestamps). Validation: status must be 'open', 'in-progress', 'completed', or 'closed'. priority must be 'low', 'medium', 'high', or 'urgent'. estimated_hours must be positive integer if provided. assigned_employee_id must reference an employee who is a project member. parent_task_id must reference a task within the same project (one-level subtask nesting only).

IHrmPlatformProject.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a new project within an organization.

This DTO contains the business data required to create a project. The project is automatically set to 'active' status upon creation, making it immediately available for task assignment and time tracking. The organization context is derived from the authenticated user's session.

Required fields include {@link name} for project identification and {@link color} as a hex color code for UI visual distinction. Optional fields allow specifying {@link description} for context, {@link budgetHours} for capacity planning, and {@link startDate}/{@link endDate} for timeline tracking.

Validation: name must be non-empty, color must be valid hex format, budget_hours must be positive if provided, end_date must not be before start_date if both provided.

IHrmPlatformEmployeeContract.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for searching and filtering employee contracts with pagination support.

This type defines the search criteria for querying employee contract records. All fields are optional, allowing flexible filtering combinations. Results are paginated and can be sorted by various fields.

Use {@link employee_id} to filter contracts for a specific employee. Date range filters ({@link start_date_from}, {@link start_date_to}, {@link end_date_from}, {@link end_date_to}) enable temporal queries. The {@link pay_period} field filters by compensation frequency (hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly). The {@link status} field distinguishes between active contracts (ongoing, end_date is null) and historical contracts (ended, end_date is set).

Pagination is controlled via {@link page} and {@link limit} parameters. Custom sorting is available through {@link sort} and {@link direction} fields.

Used to retrieve the audit trail of status changes for a specific task. All filters are optional - omitting them returns all history entries with default pagination (newest first).

Date range filtering applies to the {@link created_at} timestamp. Status filters match exact status values from the task workflow: 'open', 'in-progress', 'completed', 'closed'. Member filtering allows viewing changes made by a specific user.

IHrmPlatformTimesheet.ICreate.description:
Request payload for creating a new draft timesheet.

Contains only the week start date (Monday) for the timesheet period. The employee ownership is automatically derived from the authenticated user's context, and the week end date is calculated as six days after the start date. New timesheets are created in draft status, allowing the employee to manage timelogs before submission.

The week_start_date must be a Monday - the system validates this constraint and rejects requests with invalid dates.

IHrmPlatformTask.description:
Complete task entity representing a work item within a project.

This DTO includes all task attributes: identification (id), content (title, description), workflow tracking (status, priority), planning estimates (estimated_hours, due_date), and lifecycle timestamps (created_at, updated_at, deleted_at). It provides relational context through the parent project reference, optional employee assignment, optional parent task for subtask hierarchy, and nested subtasks array.

Task status tracks workflow progression through four states: open (new/unstarted), in-progress (actively being worked on), completed (work finished), and closed (finalized and archived). Priority indicates urgency with four levels: low, medium, high, and urgent. The subtasks array supports one-level hierarchy - subtasks cannot have their own subtasks.

This Read DTO is used for retrieving complete task details via GET /hrmPlatform/member/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}. For task creation use IHrmPlatformTask.ICreate, for updates use IHrmPlatformTask.IUpdate, and for list views use IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary.

Relations: project via JOIN to hrm_platform_projects on hrm_platform_project_id, assignedEmployee via LEFT JOIN to hrm_platform_employees on assigned_employee_id (nullable), parentTask via self-join to hrm_platform_tasks on parent_task_id (nullable). Composition: subtasks array via recursive query on parent_task_id. Excludes: histories, timelogs, timers (accessible via separate endpoints /tasks/{taskId}/histories, /timelogs, /timers).

IHrmPlatformTimelog.ICreate.description:
Request payload for creating a new timelog entry.

Represents a discrete period of work performed by the authenticated employee on a specific project. Timelogs are the foundational units of time tracking, later aggregated into weekly timesheets for approval workflows.

**Required Fields**

The date specifies when the work was performed (calendar date). The duration_minutes records total work time in minutes (must be positive). The hrm_platform_project_id references the project where work was performed (must be a project the employee is assigned to).

**Optional Fields**

The hrm_platform_task_id optionally references a specific task within the project for finer granularity. The description provides context about what work was performed. The billable flag indicates whether this time is billable to a client (defaults to true if omitted).

**Validation**

Backend validates that the employee is active and assigned to the specified project. If a task is provided, it must belong to the selected project. The date cannot be in the future, and duration must be greater than zero minutes.

IHrmPlatformTimelog.description:
Complete timelog record representing a discrete period of work performed by an employee on a specific project with optional task assignment.

Timelogs capture the fundamental unit of time tracking with date, duration, and context. Each timelog belongs to exactly one employee and one project, with optional references to a task and timesheet.

**Core Attributes**

The date field records when the work was performed. duration_minutes stores the total work time in minutes. The billable flag indicates whether this time is billable to a client. An optional description allows documentation of what work was performed.

**Relations**

The employee reference identifies who performed the work. The project reference identifies which project the work was for. The optional task reference provides finer granularity for task-level tracking. The optional timesheet reference indicates which weekly timesheet includes this timelog (null if not yet assigned).

IHrmPlatformTimesheet.description:
Weekly timesheet entity aggregating timelog entries for approval workflow.

A timesheet represents a collection of work hours logged by an employee within a specific week period (Monday to Sunday). Timesheets progress through a workflow: draft → submitted → approved or rejected. Employees create draft timesheets, submit them for review, and managers with time:approve permission can approve or reject with reasons.

The {@link employee} field references the timesheet owner. The {@link reviewer} field is populated when the timesheet is approved or rejected. The {@link status} field indicates the current workflow state. The {@link timelogs} array contains all time entries included in this timesheet period.

Approved timesheets lock all included timelogs from further editing. Rejected timesheets return to draft status with a {@link rejectionReason} explaining required corrections.

Relations: employee via employee_id JOIN to hrm_platform_employees (include as IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary), reviewer via reviewer_id JOIN to hrm_platform_members (nullable, include as IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary). Composition: timelogs array via hrm_platform_timelogs where timesheet_id matches (include as IHrmPlatformTimelog.ISummary[]).

oneOf.description:

Valid transitions:
- draft → submitted: Employee submits timesheet for approval (requires at least one timelog)
- submitted → approved: Manager approves timesheet (locks all timelogs)
- submitted → rejected: Manager rejects timesheet (requires rejection_reason)
- rejected → draft: Employee modifies and resubmits rejected timesheet

Approved timesheets cannot be modified.

IHrmPlatformTimesheet.IUpdate.description:
Timesheet update request for workflow transitions and modifications.

This DTO is used when updating an existing timesheet through the approval workflow. Employees can modify their draft timesheets or resubmit rejected timesheets. Users with time:approve permission can approve or reject submitted timesheets.

The {@link status} field controls workflow transitions: draft timesheets can be submitted, submitted timesheets can be approved or rejected, and rejected timesheets return to draft status. When rejecting a timesheet (status: rejected), the {@link rejection_reason} field should be provided to explain why the timesheet was rejected.

System-managed fields such as id, timestamps, employee_id, reviewer_id, and week period dates are excluded as they are either auto-generated, immutable, or set by the system during workflow processing.

due_date.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.due_date. Nullable datetime in ISO 8601 format. Null clears the deadline.
due_date.description:
Target completion date for the task.

Optional deadline for task completion. Used for scheduling, reminders, and identifying overdue tasks. Setting to null removes the deadline. Format is ISO 8601 datetime with timezone.

assigned_employee_id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.assigned_employee_id. Nullable UUID referencing employee who must be project member. Null unassigns the task.
assigned_employee_id.description:
Reference to the employee assigned to work on this task.

Optional assignment to a specific employee who is responsible for completing the task work. The assigned employee must be a project member of the parent project. Setting to null removes the assignment, making the task available in the project backlog.

parent_task_id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.parent_task_id. Nullable UUID for one-level subtask hierarchy. Must reference task in same project that is not itself a subtask. Null makes this a top-level task.
parent_task_id.description:
Self-reference to parent task for subtask hierarchy.

Optional reference to another task, enabling one-level subtask nesting. When present, this task is a subtask of the parent. The parent task must belong to the same project and cannot be a subtask itself. Setting to null converts this to a top-level task.

IHrmPlatformTask.IUpdate.description:
Task update request payload for modifying task attributes.

This DTO is used when updating an existing task within a project. The title field is required, while all other fields are optional to support partial updates. Status changes are automatically recorded in the task history audit trail.

The assigned_employee_id must reference an employee who is a project member of the parent project. The parent_task_id enables one-level subtask hierarchy - subtasks cannot have their own subtasks.
IHrmPlatformTask.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification: Maps to hrm_platform_tasks table fields: title, description, status, priority, estimated_hours, due_date, assigned_employee_id, parent_task_id. Excludes: id (auto), hrm_platform_project_id (path param), created_at/updated_at/deleted_at (system). Validation: status must be one of (open, in-progress, completed, closed), priority must be one of (low, medium, high, urgent), estimated_hours must be positive integer (minimum 1), due_date must be valid datetime if provided, assigned_employee_id must reference employee who is project member, parent_task_id must reference task in same project that is not itself a subtask.

status.description:
Filter timesheets by their workflow status.

Accepts one of four status values: draft, submitted, approved, or rejected. When provided, only timesheets matching the specified status are returned.

Employees typically filter by their own timesheet statuses. Users with time:approve permission often filter by submitted status to find timesheets awaiting review.
status.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter filtering hrm_platform_timesheets.status. Enum values: draft, submitted, approved, rejected. Backend performs exact string match. Optional - if omitted, returns timesheets of all statuses accessible to the user.

week_start_date_gte.description:
Filter timesheets by week start date (greater than or equal to).

Accepts an ISO 8601 date-time string. Returns only timesheets where the week_start_date is on or after the specified date.

Commonly used with week_start_date_lte to define a date range for reporting periods or historical queries.
week_start_date_gte.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter filtering hrm_platform_timesheets.week_start_date with >= comparison. ISO 8601 date-time format. Optional - if omitted, no lower bound is applied. Used with week_start_date_lte to define a date range.

week_start_date_lte.description:
Filter timesheets by week start date (less than or equal to).

Accepts an ISO 8601 date-time string. Returns only timesheets where the week_start_date is on or before the specified date.

Commonly used with week_start_date_gte to define a date range for reporting periods or historical queries.
week_start_date_lte.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter filtering hrm_platform_timesheets.week_start_date with <= comparison. ISO 8601 date-time format. Optional - if omitted, no upper bound is applied. Used with week_start_date_gte to define a date range.

employee_id.description:
Filter timesheets by employee ID.

Accepts a UUID string matching an employee record. When provided, returns only timesheets belonging to the specified employee.

Regular employees cannot use this filter - they always see only their own timesheets. Users with time:approve permission can specify an employee_id to review timesheets for a specific employee across the organization.
employee_id.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter filtering hrm_platform_timesheets.employee_id by UUID. Optional - if omitted, defaults to authenticated user's employee record for regular employees. Users with time:approve permission can specify any employee_id to view that employee's timesheets across the organization.

take.description:
Number of timesheet records to retrieve per page.

Controls the page size for pagination. Must be between 1 and 100. If omitted, defaults to 100 records.

Used in conjunction with skip to implement cursor-based pagination. For example, take=20 and skip=0 retrieves the first 20 records, while skip=20 retrieves the next 20.
take.x-autobe-specification: Cursor-based pagination parameter specifying number of items to retrieve. Integer between 1 and 100. Defaults to 100 if omitted. Used with skip for offset-based cursor pagination. Backend enforces maximum of 100 to prevent excessive resource consumption.

skip.description:
Number of timesheet records to skip before starting to return results.

Controls the offset for cursor-based pagination. Must be 0 or greater. If omitted, defaults to 0 (start from first record).

Used in conjunction with take. For example, to retrieve page 2 with a page size of 20, use take=20 and skip=20.
skip.x-autobe-specification: Cursor-based pagination parameter specifying number of items to skip. Integer >= 0. Defaults to 0 if omitted. Used with take for offset-based cursor pagination. Represents the offset from the beginning of the result set.

sort.description:
Sort order for the timesheet list results.

Specify sorting as field:direction format, such as week_start_date:DESC or status:ASC. Supported fields include week_start_date, status, and created_at. Direction can be ASC (ascending) or DESC (descending).

If omitted, defaults to week_start_date:DESC, showing the most recent weeks first.
sort.x-autobe-specification: Sorting parameter in field:direction format. Supported fields: week_start_date, status, created_at. Directions: ASC (ascending) or DESC (descending). Defaults to week_start_date:DESC if omitted. Backend validates field names and direction values.

page.description:
Target page number to retrieve (1-indexed).

Specifies which page of results to return. Page numbering starts from 1. If omitted, null, or undefined, defaults to page 1 (first page).

Requesting a page beyond the available range returns an empty data array with valid pagination metadata reflecting the actual totals. Used with limit for page-based pagination.
page.x-autobe-specification: 1-indexed page number for pagination. Integer >= 0. Defaults to 1 (first page) if omitted or null. Used with limit for page-based pagination alternative to take/skip. Requesting a page beyond available range returns empty data array with valid pagination metadata.

limit.description:
Maximum number of records to return per page.

Controls how many records are included in each page response. If omitted, null, or undefined, defaults to 100 records per page.

The server may enforce upper bounds to prevent excessive resource consumption on large requests. Used with page for page-based pagination, alternative to take/skip cursor pagination.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Maximum number of records per page for page-based pagination. Integer >= 0. Defaults to 100 if omitted or null. Used with page as alternative to take/skip cursor pagination. Backend may enforce upper bounds to prevent excessive resource consumption.

IHrmPlatformTimesheet.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for filtering and paginating timesheet lists.

This type provides search criteria for querying timesheets. Employees can filter their own timesheets by status and date range, while users with time:approve permission can additionally filter by employee and view all submitted timesheets across the organization.

The status field filters by timesheet workflow state. Date range filters operate on the timesheet week period. Cursor-based pagination is controlled by take and skip, with sort specifying the ordering. Page and limit provide alternative pagination control.

All fields are optional - omitting filters returns all accessible timesheets with default pagination.
IHrmPlatformTimesheet.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Query parameters for the PATCH /hrmPlatform/member/timesheets endpoint. Filters: status (enum match on hrm_platform_timesheets.status), week_start_date_gte/lte (range filter on hrm_platform_timesheets.week_start_date), employee_id (filter on hrm_platform_timesheets.employee_id for users with time:approve permission). Pagination: take (items per page, 1-100), skip (offset for cursor-based pagination), sort (field:direction format), page (1-indexed page number), limit (max records per page, defaults to 100). Backend applies organization context automatically - regular employees see only their own timesheets, users with time:approve see all submitted timesheets across organization.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the employee invitation.

Auto-generated UUID that uniquely identifies this invitation record in the system. Used for reference in API operations such as retrieving, updating, or canceling specific invitations.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_invitations.id. UUID format.

email.description:
Email address of the invited person.

The email address to which the invitation was sent. When a user registers with this email address, the invitation is automatically accepted and the user is added to the organization. Must be unique within the organization.
email.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_invitations.email. Email format validation.

position.description:
Job title or position for the invited employee.

Optional field capturing the intended role title such as 'Software Engineer' or 'Project Manager'. Stored for reference and displayed in the employee list upon acceptance. Can be null if no position was specified during invitation.
position.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_invitations.position. Nullable string for job title.

employment_type.description:
Employment classification for the invited employee.

Captures the intended employment type: full-time, part-time, contractor, or intern. This determines the employee's classification in the organization's HR records and may affect benefits eligibility and reporting.
employment_type.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_invitations.employment_type. Enum values: full-time, part-time, contractor, intern.

status.description:
Current status of the invitation.

Tracks the invitation lifecycle through four states: 'pending' (awaiting acceptance), 'accepted' (user signed up and joined), 'expired' (past expiration date without acceptance), or 'cancelled' (manually cancelled by the inviter). Used for filtering and workflow management.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_invitations.status. Enum values: pending, accepted, expired, cancelled.

invited_at.description:
Timestamp when the invitation was sent.

Records when the invitation was created and sent to the email address. Used for tracking invitation age, calculating expiration, and audit purposes. Immutable after creation.
invited_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_invitations.invited_at. ISO 8601 date-time format.

expires_at.description:
Timestamp when the invitation expires.

Invitations have a limited validity period. After this timestamp, the invitation status automatically becomes 'expired' and cannot be accepted. The expiration period is configured by the organization's invitation settings.
expires_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_invitations.expires_at. ISO 8601 date-time format.

accepted_at.description:
Timestamp when the invitation was accepted.

Set when the user signs up with the invited email address and is automatically added to the organization. Null for pending, expired, or cancelled invitations. Used to track conversion rate and onboarding timelines.
accepted_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_invitations.accepted_at. Nullable ISO 8601 date-time format. Set when status becomes 'accepted'.

created_at.description:
Record creation timestamp.

Automatically set when the invitation record is created in the database. Used for audit trails, sorting invitations by creation date, and determining record age. Immutable after creation.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_invitations.created_at. ISO 8601 date-time format.

updated_at.description:
Record last update timestamp.

Automatically updated whenever the invitation record is modified, such as when status changes or expiration date is extended. Used for change tracking and cache invalidation.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_invitations.updated_at. ISO 8601 date-time format.

deleted_at.description:
Soft delete timestamp for record retention.

Null for active invitations. When set, marks the invitation as deleted while preserving the record for audit purposes. Soft-deleted invitations are excluded from normal list queries unless explicitly requested.
deleted_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_invitations.deleted_at. Nullable ISO 8601 date-time format. Null for active records.

invitedBy.description:
The member who sent this invitation.

References the user account with employee:manage permission who initiated the invitation. Used for audit purposes and to identify the point of contact for the invited employee. Returns summary information including the member's email and profile details.
invitedBy.x-autobe-specification: JOIN from hrm_platform_employee_invitations.invited_by to hrm_platform_members.id. Returns IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary.

role.description:
The role to be assigned when the invitation is accepted.

Determines the permissions the invited employee will have in the organization. Must reference a valid role within the same organization. Returns summary information including the role name and built-in status.
role.x-autobe-specification: JOIN from hrm_platform_employee_invitations.role_id to hrm_platform_roles.id. Returns IHrmPlatformRole.ISummary.

department.description:
The optional department assignment for the invited employee.

If set, the employee will be assigned to this department upon accepting the invitation. Can be null if no department assignment was specified during invitation. Returns summary information including the department name and parent department relationship.
department.x-autobe-specification: Optional JOIN from hrm_platform_employee_invitations.department_id to hrm_platform_departments.id. Returns IHrmPlatformDepartment.ISummary or null.

IHrmPlatformEmployeeInvitation.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of an employee invitation for list views and administrative interfaces.

Displays essential invitation information including the invited email address, position title, employment type classification, current invitation status, and key timestamps. Includes references to the member who sent the invitation, the assigned role, and optional department assignment.

Used in paginated list responses for administrative review of pending and historical employee invitations. Supports filtering by status and email to help administrators manage the invitation workflow.
IHrmPlatformEmployeeInvitation.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_invitations table. Scalar fields: id, email, position, employment_type, status, invited_at, expires_at, accepted_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at. Relations: invitedBy via JOIN to hrm_platform_members (ISummary), role via JOIN to hrm_platform_roles (ISummary), department via optional JOIN to hrm_platform_departments (ISummary). Excluded: organization_id and organization relation (from session context), invited_by/role_id/department_id FK columns (replaced by $ref objects), emailVerification has-many relation (not needed in summary).

from.description:
Start of the date range for filtering weekly summaries.

Filters the results to include only weeks where the week start date (Monday) is greater than or equal to this value. Uses ISO 8601 date-time format.

Optional parameter. When omitted, the query includes all available weeks from the earliest recorded data.
from.x-autobe-specification: Filters timelogs where week_start_date >= from. ISO 8601 date-time format. Optional - omitting returns all weeks from earliest available.

to.description:
End of the date range for filtering weekly summaries.

Filters the results to include only weeks where the week end date (Sunday) is less than or equal to this value. Uses ISO 8601 date-time format.

Optional parameter. When omitted, the query includes all available weeks up to the most recent data.
to.x-autobe-specification: Filters timelogs where week_end_date <= to. ISO 8601 date-time format. Optional - omitting returns all weeks up to latest.

project_id.description:
Optional project filter to analyze project-specific weekly patterns.

When provided, filters the weekly summaries to include only timelogs associated with the specified project. The value must be a valid project UUID from the organization.

Optional parameter. When omitted, the query aggregates timelogs across all projects in the organization.
project_id.x-autobe-specification: Filters timelogs by hrm_platform_project_id when provided. UUID format. Optional - omitting includes all projects.

page.description:
Page number for pagination (1-indexed).

Specifies which page of results to retrieve. Page numbering starts from 1, so the first page is page 1.

Optional parameter. Defaults to 1 when omitted. Used in conjunction with limit to implement cursor-based pagination sorted by week_start_date DESC.
page.x-autobe-specification: Page number for cursor-based pagination using week_start_date. Minimum 1, defaults to 1. Used with limit to control result window.

limit.description:
Maximum number of records per page.

Defines the upper bound on how many weekly summary records are returned in a single response. Must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

Optional parameter. Defaults to 100 when omitted. The actual number of records returned may be less on the final page or when total weeks are fewer than the limit.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Maximum records per page. Minimum 1, maximum 100, defaults to 100. Controls result set size for efficient retrieval.

IHrmPlatformWeeklySummaryReport.IRequest.description:
Search criteria for weekly summary report including date range filter, optional project filter, and pagination parameters.

This request type defines the filtering and pagination options for retrieving weekly time tracking summaries. The date range filters allow focusing on specific periods, while the project filter enables analysis of project-specific weekly patterns. Pagination parameters control the result set size for efficient data retrieval.

All fields are optional. Omitting date filters returns all available weeks. Omitting project filter includes all projects. Default pagination returns the first page with up to 100 items.
IHrmPlatformWeeklySummaryReport.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Request DTO for weekly summary report filtering. All properties are query parameters: from/to filter ISO week date range (week_start_date >= from AND week_end_date <= to), project_id filters by hrm_platform_project_id in timelogs, page/limit control cursor-based pagination using week_start_date as cursor. All fields optional - empty request returns all weeks with default pagination (page=1, limit=100).

description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timers.description. Nullable string for work notes. Editable while timer is running.
description.description:
Optional description of the work being tracked.

Employees can add notes about what specific work they are doing during this timer session. This field is editable while the timer is running to allow updates as work context changes. Null value indicates no description provided.

hrm_platform_project_id.description: Reference to the project being tracked by this timer.

hrm_platform_task_id.description: Reference to the optional task being tracked by this timer.

IHrmPlatformTimer.IUpdate.description:
Update request for modifying a running timer session.

This DTO contains the mutable fields of a timer that employees can update while the timer is actively running. Employees can change the work description, switch to a different project, or update the task assignment.

All properties are optional - include only the fields you want to update. The timer must be owned by the requesting employee and must still be running (not yet stopped). Once a timer is stopped, it cannot be modified.
IHrmPlatformTimer.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification: Maps to hrm_platform_timers table. Mutable fields: description, hrm_platform_project_id, hrm_platform_task_id. Validation: project must be one employee is assigned to, task must belong to selected project. Timer must be running (stopped_at is null). Excluded: hrm_platform_employee_id (from JWT), started_at/stopped_at (immutable), timestamps (auto-managed).

search.description:
Text search query matching against action type, target entity type, and details fields.

Performs a case-insensitive search across multiple columns to find relevant activity log entries. Useful for finding specific actions or entities without knowing the exact action type or filtering criteria.
search.x-autobe-specification: Text search across action_type, target_entity_type, and details columns using LIKE query. Not a direct DB column mapping - implements multi-field search logic.

actionType.description:
Filter by specific action type (e.g., employee:invite, contract:create, timesheet:approve).

Narrows results to a specific category of logged actions. Common values include employee:invite, employee:deactivate, employee:reactivate, contract:create, contract:edit, timesheet:submit, timesheet:approve, timesheet:reject, task:status-change, project:create, project:archive, project:complete, project:delete, role:assign, role:change.
actionType.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_logs.action_type. Filters by exact match on action type (e.g., employee:invite, contract:create, timesheet:approve).

userId.description:
Filter by the member who performed the action.

Restricts results to activity log entries where the specified user was the actor. Useful for auditing actions by a specific individual. Must be a valid member UUID.
userId.x-autobe-specification: Maps to hrm_platform_activity_logs.hrm_platform_member_id. Filters activity logs by the member who performed the action. Expects UUID format.

dateFrom.description:
Filter entries created on or after this date (inclusive).

Sets the start of the date range for filtering activity logs. All entries with created_at on or after this date will be included. Use ISO date format (YYYY-MM-DD).
dateFrom.x-autobe-specification: Computed filter parameter. Applies >= filter on hrm_platform_activity_logs.created_at. Expects date format (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive of the specified date.

dateTo.description:
Filter entries created on or before this date (inclusive).

Sets the end of the date range for filtering activity logs. All entries with created_at on or before this date will be included. Use ISO date format (YYYY-MM-DD).
dateTo.x-autobe-specification: Computed filter parameter. Applies <= filter on hrm_platform_activity_logs.created_at. Expects date format (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive of the specified date.

page.description:
Page number for pagination (1-indexed, default: 1).

Specifies which page of results to retrieve. Page numbering starts from 1, so the first page is page 1. Used in combination with the limit parameter to control result set size.
page.x-autobe-specification: Pagination control parameter. 1-indexed page number. Defaults to 1 if not provided. Used with limit to calculate OFFSET for SQL query.

limit.description:
Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100).

Controls how many activity log entries are returned in a single response. Higher values reduce the number of API calls needed but increase response size. Capped at 100 for performance.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Pagination control parameter. Number of items per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100. Used with page to calculate LIMIT for SQL query.

IHrmPlatformActivityLog.IRequest.description:
Search criteria for querying activity log entries with filtering and pagination support.

Provides flexible filtering options to audit specific categories of events within the organization. Supports filtering by action type to focus on specific event categories, by user to track actions by specific individuals, and by date range to audit activities within specific time periods. Text search spans action types, target entity types, and details.

Pagination parameters enable efficient browsing of historical records with results ordered by creation timestamp descending.
IHrmPlatformActivityLog.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Request body for filtering and paginating activity log queries. Maps: actionType → action_type (exact match filter), userId → hrm_platform_member_id (UUID filter), dateFrom/dateTo → created_at range filter (inclusive), search → LIKE query across action_type, target_entity_type, and details columns. Pagination: page (1-indexed, default 1), limit (default 20, max 100). All fields optional. Organization context (hrm_platform_organization_id) is resolved from JWT, not user-provided.

rejection_reason.description:
Explanation provided when rejecting a timesheet.

This field helps employees understand why their timesheet was rejected and what corrections are needed before resubmission. The rejection reason is stored in the timesheet record and displayed to the employee.

This field is mandatory in the reject request. The server validates that a non-empty reason is provided.
rejection_reason.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to hrm_platform_timesheets.rejection_reason column. DB column is nullable (only populated on rejection). For IReject request DTO this field is required and must be provided (non-empty string validated by server).

IHrmPlatformTimesheet.IReject.description:
Request body for rejecting a submitted timesheet.

Contains the mandatory rejection reason that explains why the timesheet was rejected. This reason is recorded in the timesheet record and visible to the employee so they understand what corrections are needed before resubmission.

Only the rejection_reason field is provided by the user. The server automatically sets the reviewer (from JWT), review timestamp, and status change when processing the rejection.
IHrmPlatformTimesheet.IReject.x-autobe-specification: Request DTO for timesheet rejection. Only rejection_reason is user-provided and maps to hrm_platform_timesheets.rejection_reason column. All other fields are server-managed: reviewer_id resolved from JWT member_id, reviewed_at set to current timestamp by server, status set to 'rejected' by server. The timesheetId comes from the URL path parameter, not the request body.

employee.description:
The employee associated with this time aggregation.

Populated only when the report is grouped by employee. Contains the employee's summary information including their role, department, and employment details. Null when the report is grouped by project or task.
